title: Cross-Platform vs Native Mobile Development: An Empirical Study of Software Quality Trade-offs
abstract: arXiv:2609.21544v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Cross-platform mobile frameworks promise code reuse, shorter delivery cycles, and lower implementation effort, but their trade-offs relative to native development remain difficult to assess objectively. Many comparisons rely on simplified applications, inconsistent feature sets, or a narrow set of metrics. This paper compares five implementations of the same plant-management application: native iOS, native Android, Flutter, React Native, and Kotlin Multiplatform. The shared approaches target both Android and iOS, yielding eight executable variants. Guided by ISO/IEC 25010, the study examines time behavior, implementation footprint, source-code organization, and observable rendering responsiveness.   All implementations share the same domain, backend services, functional requirements, and benchmark contract. translated_title: 跨平台与原生移动开发对比：软件质量权衡的实证研究
translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.21544v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：跨平台移动开发框架承诺代码复用、更短的交付周期和更低的实现成本，但其相对于原生开发的权衡仍难以客观评估。许多已有比较依赖于简化的应用、不一致的功能集或狭窄的指标集合。本文对同一款植物管理应用的五种实现进行了比较：原生iOS、原生Android、Flutter、React Native和Kotlin Multiplatform。共享方法同时面向Android和iOS两个平台，共产生八个可执行变体。在ISO/IEC 25010标准的指导下，本研究考察了时间行为、实现占用空间、源代码组织以及可观察的渲染响应性。所有实现共享相同的领域模型、后端服务、功能需求和基准测试契约。所提供的数据集包含每个变体2000次完整运行，涵盖身份认证与缓存检索、图像传输与解码等场景。
tldr: 本文基于ISO/IEC 25010标准，对同一植物管理应用的原生iOS、原生Android、Flutter、React Native和Kotlin Multiplatform五种实现（共八个可执行变体）开展了包含每变体2000次运行的大规模实证比较，客观量化了跨平台与原生移动开发在软件质量上的权衡。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a large-scale empirical comparison of five implementations (eight executable variants) of the same plant-management app—native iOS, native Android, Flutter, React Native, and Kotlin Multiplatform—guided by ISO/IEC 25010 with 2,000 runs per variant, to objectively quantify software quality trade-offs between cross-platform and native mobile development.
